input.body:
label: bug
file: none

Thanks for the report. This looks like a timezone-handling bug in the scheduled job that sends the weekly summary email: it appears to compute "Monday" using a reference timezone (likely UTC or the server's local time) rather than each account's configured timezone, so users far ahead of that reference (like Sydney, UTC+10/11) only cross into "Monday" in the scheduling window after it has already run, pushing their email to the next day, while users closer to the reference timezone (like London) are unaffected. We weren't able to pin down the exact source file in this pass, but the fix should ensure the summary scheduler resolves "Monday morning" per-account using the account's stored timezone rather than a single global reference time.
